label: Even light
instructions: Is the light on the faces fairly even?
true_description: The faces are lit fairly evenly.
false_description: One side of a face falls into a deep shadow while the other is bright.

label: Balanced exposure
instructions: Is the exposure balanced, with detail in the bright areas and the dark areas?
true_description: Bright areas and dark areas both keep visible detail.
false_description: The frame is mostly washed out or mostly sunk into darkness.

label: Faces are lit
instructions: Are the faces lit?
true_description: The faces receive clear light.
false_description: A face is left in shadow.

label: Harsh backlight
instructions: Is harsh backlight turning the faces into silhouettes?
true_description: Strong backlight silhouettes a face.
false_description: Backlight, if any, stays gentle.

label: Blown highlights
instructions: Are bright areas clipped to pure white?
true_description: A bright area is clipped to pure white, with detail gone.
false_description: Bright areas still hold detail.

label: Crushed shadows
instructions: Are dark areas crushed to solid black?
true_description: A dark area is solid black, with detail gone.
false_description: Dark areas still hold detail.

label: Catchlights
instructions: Are small catchlights visible in the eyes?
true_description: A small reflection of the light is visible in an eye.
false_description: The eyes show no catchlight.

label: Nice and sharp
instructions: Is the main subject sharp?
true_description: The main subject is sharp.
false_description: The main subject is soft.

label: Sharp eyes
instructions: Are the eyes sharp?
true_description: The eyes are sharp.
false_description: The eyes are soft.

label: Motion blur
instructions: Is motion blur visible on the people?
true_description: A person is streaked by motion blur.
false_description: The people are free of motion blur.

label: Camera shake
instructions: Does the whole frame look smeared?
true_description: The whole frame is smeared, as from camera shake.
false_description: The frame is steady.

label: Focus on the people
instructions: Is the focus on the people rather than the background?
true_description: Focus sits on the people.
false_description: The background is sharp while the people are soft.

label: Everyone sharp
instructions: Is every person in the frame sharp?
true_description: Every person in the frame is sharp.
false_description: One person is noticeably softer than the others.

label: Eyes open
instructions: Are everyone's eyes open?
true_description: Every visible pair of eyes is open.
false_description: Someone's eyes are closed.

label: Looking at the camera
instructions: Is everyone looking toward the camera?
true_description: The people look toward the camera.
false_description: Someone looks away from the camera.

label: Red-eye
instructions: Is red-eye visible?
true_description: Red-eye is visible.
false_description: Red-eye is absent.

label: Mid-blink
instructions: Is anyone caught mid-blink?
true_description: Someone is caught mid-blink.
false_description: No one is mid-blink.

label: Glasses glare
instructions: Is glare hiding someone's eyes?
true_description: Glare on glasses hides an eye.
false_description: Eyes behind glasses, if any, stay visible.

label: Faces turned forward
instructions: Are the faces turned toward the camera?
true_description: The faces are turned toward the camera.
false_description: A face is turned fully away.

label: Eyes clear
instructions: Are the eyes free of hair or hands covering them?
true_description: The eyes are uncovered.
false_description: Hair or a hand covers an eye.

label: Relaxed smile
instructions: Do the smiles look relaxed?
true_description: The smiles look relaxed.
false_description: A smile looks tight or strained.

label: At ease
instructions: Does the expression look at ease?
true_description: The expression looks at ease.
false_description: The expression looks strained.

label: Shared mood
instructions: If more than one person is shown, do their expressions fit together?
true_description: The expressions fit together.
false_description: The expressions clash, or only one person was meant to be posing.

label: Squinting
instructions: Is anyone squinting hard?
true_description: Someone is squinting hard.
false_description: The eyes are open without a hard squint.

label: Easy expression
instructions: Does the expression look easy?
true_description: The expression looks easy.
false_description: The expression looks forced.

label: Cut off at the edge
instructions: Is a person cut off by the frame edge?
true_description: The frame cuts through a person.
false_description: Each person sits fully inside the frame, or is cropped on purpose at the chest.

label: Head cropped
instructions: Is a head cropped by the frame?
true_description: The frame crops through a head.
false_description: Each head is fully inside the frame.

label: Upright background
instructions: Is the background upright, with a level horizon where one is visible?
true_description: Verticals and the horizon, where visible, sit level.
false_description: The background leans, or the horizon tilts.

label: Balanced placement
instructions: Does the subject sit near the centre or on a third?
true_description: The subject sits near the centre or near a third.
false_description: The subject is jammed into a corner.

label: Room above the head
instructions: Is there a little space above the head?
true_description: A little space sits above the head.
false_description: The head touches the top edge, or a large empty gap hangs above it.

label: Face is large enough
instructions: Does a face fill a generous part of the frame?
true_description: A face is large enough to read clearly.
false_description: The faces are tiny in the frame.

label: Works as a square crop
instructions: Would a square crop still include the head?
true_description: A square crop can keep the head inside.
false_description: A square crop would slice the head.

label: Camera tilt
instructions: Are the people leaning because the camera is tilted?
true_description: The camera tilt makes the people lean.
false_description: The camera is level.

label: Space around the subject
instructions: Is there comfortable space around the subject?
true_description: Comfortable space surrounds the subject.
false_description: The subject is pressed against the frame.

label: Shoulders in frame
instructions: Are the shoulders in the frame?
true_description: The shoulders are in the frame.
false_description: The crop cuts through the neck or the chin.

label: Tidy background
instructions: Is the background tidy?
true_description: The background is tidy.
false_description: The background is messy.

label: Busy background
instructions: Does the background pull attention away from the subject?
true_description: The background competes with the subject.
false_description: The background stays quiet.

label: Object on the head
instructions: Does a pole, tree, or lamp appear to grow out of a head?
true_description: A pole, tree, or lamp lines up with a head.
false_description: Nothing lines up as if it grows from a head.

label: Photobomber
instructions: Is an extra person prominent behind the subject?
true_description: An extra person is prominent in the background.
false_description: The background has no prominent extra person.

label: Lens flare
instructions: Is lens flare washing across the frame?
true_description: Lens flare washes across the frame.
false_description: Lens flare is absent.

label: Clutter behind
instructions: Is clutter sitting right behind the subject?
true_description: Clutter sits directly behind the subject.
false_description: The area behind the subject is clear.

label: Subject stands out
instructions: Does the subject stand out from the background?
true_description: The subject separates clearly from the background.
false_description: The subject blends into the background.

label: Natural colours
instructions: Do the colours look natural?
true_description: The colours look natural.
false_description: The colours look off.

label: Colour cast
instructions: Is a strong colour cast visible?
true_description: A strong colour cast covers the frame.
false_description: The frame has no strong colour cast.

label: Harsh saturation
instructions: Are the colours harshly oversaturated?
true_description: The colours are harshly oversaturated.
false_description: The saturation looks moderate.

label: Consistent colour
instructions: Is the colour consistent across the frame?
true_description: Colour stays consistent across the frame.
false_description: Different parts of the frame shift to different casts.

label: Neutral white balance
instructions: Does the white balance look neutral?
true_description: Whites and greys look neutral.
false_description: Whites and greys lean strongly warm or cool.

label: Square crop keeps the face
instructions: Does a square profile crop keep the face intact?
true_description: A square crop can keep the face intact.
false_description: A square crop would cut the face.

label: Face fills the frame
instructions: Does the face take up enough of the frame for a profile picture?
true_description: The face is large enough for a profile picture.
false_description: The face is too small for a profile picture.

label: Clear subject
instructions: Is there one clear subject, or a clear pair?
true_description: One person, or a clear pair, is the subject.
false_description: The frame has no clear subject.
